The '''Select Committee''' was the ruling body of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]].<ref name="ISB" /> The Select Committee was headed by [[Ishin-Il-Raz]] at its inception in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="I84" /> and had a variable number of members. The COMPNOR charter provided for electoral and honorary means of being named a member of the Select Committee. At its height, the Select Committee numbered over 25,000 members, but [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] took interest in the body, and the membership dropped dramatically. Estimates on the Committee's membership ranged from 15,000 to 150 depending on the rank of the estimator, but the Committee refused to clear up the confusion surrounding the matter.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
